assetBaseline: RC21 preserves the 105 existing brand, product and archived-reading images and adds 78 complete, independently sourced public-domain Rider–Waite–Smith card faces from the original 1909 Roses & Lilies edition. The active reading experience focuses on tarot and natal astrology; legacy rune and I Ching assets remain available for old records.

decisions.runes: No logo; exact original image restored
decisions.tea: No logo; exact original image restored
decisions.oracle: No logo; exact original image restored
decisions.yi: No logo; exact original image restored
decisions.journal: Small low-contrast blind deboss near lower cover edge
decisions.parfum: Existing MARÉVYS minimal ivory rectangular-label design selected; small circular emblem, fine serif wordmark, PARIS and EAU 01; own brand retained
decisions.object: Approved emblem in bronze on enamel pendant
decisions.ritual: Small approved emblem on a matte ivory rectangular paper label; oversized ceramic monogram removed; coordinated with the selected perfume
decisions.hero: Original water landscape preserved; overlaid hero logo elements removed
decisions.logo: Approved transparent emblem retained as the only repeatable brand UI asset; top-left navigation emblems return to home
decisions.oneImageOnePurpose: Every non-logo photograph has one named semantic purpose; homepage, catalogue, matched-set, ritual-bookmark, record scenes and all 24 blind-selection rune stones do not recycle the same photograph.
decisions.noLargeImageSlicing: Every card face and product image is an independent full composition; no large image is sliced into smaller products.
decisions.productDetail: Catalogue photography is not repeated in product detail; the modal uses a CSS material signature and textual energy explanation
decisions.newNoLogoProducts: STONE 24, CLOTH 01, ARCANA 22 and COIN 64 remain unbranded; rune stones, energy stones, tea bowls, Tarot cards and I Ching coins carry no logo.
decisions.newSubtleLogoProducts: PULSE 01, MEDALLION 01 and EMBER 01 use one small physically integrated version of the approved emblem
decisions.runeInterpretation: The former photographic rune inset is removed. The selected rune and full interpretation are rendered as crisp incised type on one CSS-built basalt tablet.
decisions.tarotFaces: The active tarot experience uses all 78 original 1909 Rider–Waite–Smith faces with documented provenance, contained at their native ratio. The earlier 22 mineral-watercolour faces remain preserved for legacy records and catalogue compositions.
decisions.iching: The reading scene uses exactly three square-hole bronze coins beside blank xuan paper so it never contradicts the dynamically cast hexagram; the catalogue uses a separate three-coin product composition.
decisions.tarotProductConsistency: The active 78-card online reading uses classic Rider–Waite–Smith faces. ARCANA 22 catalogue photography retains its earlier 22-card product design; it must not be described as the same complete deck.
decisions.catalogueFormat: All twelve single-product catalogue photographs are delivered at the same 1024 × 1280 (4:5) format and fill the same image frame.
decisions.readingMaterials: Rune interpretation uses crisp incised basalt, Tarot uses fine navy-gold card stock and I Ching uses warm xuan paper; none stretches a landscape photograph over a long page.
decisions.ritualBookmarks: Each of the twelve products has a separate 2:3 image made for the stage-six bookmark sequence; no catalogue image or matched-set crop is reused.
decisions.recordSurface: The saved-reading page uses one dedicated open RETURN 01 notebook scene and keeps the reader’s note on the paper surface.
decisions.matchPortraits: Each of the twelve products has a separate 4:5 identification portrait on the private-match page so a reader can see exactly what every named object is.
decisions.tarotProvenance: Original 1909 illustrations by Pamela Colman Smith, scans by Saskia Jansen, Wikimedia Commons public-domain metadata; complete source URLs and hashes in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/RWS_1909_PROVENANCE.json.
